title: ParentCandidate.link_etx public field allows invalid construction
description: File: rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs Lines 150-157. The ParentCandidate struct has public fields including link_etx. While process_dio validates link_etx >= 1.0 and is_finite(), external callers can construct ParentCandidate directly with invalid values (NaN, negative, < 1.0) and call path_cost(). The path_cost method handles some invalid values (NaN, negative) but not link_etx < 1.0 which would produce path_cost < parent.rank, violating RPL invariants. Consider private fields with a constructor that validates, or document the invariant.
